Kizo Kicks / Commercial

Moon Rocks

Miami, Florida / 202424 photographs
About the project

For KIZO Kicks’ Fall 2024 release, I conceptualized and directed the “Moonrocks” campaign — a futuristic, lab-inspired visual series presenting sneakers as studied artifacts. Shot in a Miami studio, the creative direction leaned into fashion editorial and product surrealism, with full set design, styling, and costume elements crafted to echo scientific research environments.

As creative director, I handled every element from pre-production and team building to photography, videography, editing, and color. With models Mawntel and Samantha front and center, the campaign blends fashion and function in a uniquely immersive visual language.
